citation.title: Research on topology optimization of carbon fiber reinforced composite electric vehicle helmet based on deep learning
citation.authors: Xiangkui Zhang; Wei Wei; Ping Hu; Chengxiang Han

notes: The Crossref abstract describes a U-Net trained on designs from a variable-density optimizer and compares the optimized helmet with an ordinary helmet, but does not establish an optimization-level comparison with a classical method.
